heading: Plan events with us!
body: Are you interested in event hosting, planning, hospitality, venue relations/promotion, or marketing? Regardless of experience, we'd love to hear from you!

ambassador.heading: Become a DSC Brand Ambassador
ambassador.body: Ambassadors represent DSC at events and online. They welcome the people who came alone, share the nights with their networks, and help set the tone of the room.

work.heading: Host a DSC night
work.body: We bring hundreds of young professionals out for nights of dancing, live music, and socializing, and we're always looking for great places to host them. We work with wineries, barns, hotel ballrooms, restaurants, bars, marinas, and other venues with enough space for a crowd and a dance floor. DSC handles the event, entertainment, dance lesson, ticketing, and promotion. You provide the space and hospitality. Interested in hosting a DSC night? We'd love to hear from you.

ambassadorCard.heading: Become a brand ambassador
ambassadorCard.body: DSC ambassadors help us welcome new people, spread the word, and make each event feel like a community rather than just a crowd. In return, ambassadors receive free admission with a guest, early access to ticket links, a profile on our website, and invitations to ambassador gatherings throughout the year. We keep the group small and typically add only one or two new ambassadors each year.

music.heading: Play at our events
music.body: Live music and great DJs are a big part of what makes our events work. We're always interested in hearing from bands that play swing, country, Latin, jazz, big band, and other music people can dance to. If you're a band or DJ interested in playing a DSC event, send us a little about yourself, where you've played, and a link where we can hear you.

sponsor.heading: Sponsor an event
sponsor.body: DSC events bring together hundreds of young professionals for nights built around dancing, live music, and meeting new people. Sponsorship puts your business in front of that audience, both at the event and through our promotion leading up to it. Sponsor the full evening or a specific part of the night, from the band or DJ to the bar or dance lesson. We'll work with you on a partnership that makes sense for your business.

donate.heading: Donate
donate.body: Ticket sales cover the nights. Gifts cover everything between them, the free lessons, the outreach, and the new venues we try.

social.heading: Tag us and collaborate with us
social.body: Everything good that happens at a DSC night ends up on somebody phone. Tag us in your photos, reels, and stories and we will share them with the whole list. If you make things for a living, a photographer, a videographer, a creator, or a brand with something to say to a few hundred young professionals, send us a note and we will plan a post together.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: We are growing the young adult scene in DC, MD, and VA one event at a time. Contact us to learn more about our mission and work, or to become involved yourself.
